note: ToolRelevanceClassifier. select(prompt, items) -> selected/dropped (names, in input order). One noul per item keyed by its name. Only a confident no (p < low) drops an item; yes, uncertain and missing keep it. Error: onError open keeps all, closed keeps none. No items: no classifier call, both lists empty.
